overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long CRDO Daily ETF (CRDU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Credo Technology Group stock. CRDU was launched on Sep 15, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
